title: jint_strict silently defaults non-numeric JSON values (String/Boolean/Null) instead of failing fast — ODN-5 gap in the new 3.1 loaders
detail: json.String/Boolean/Null values fall through the switch to (def, true): "volume": "high" loads as 0, "start_tick": "soon" as 0, "demand_weight": "big" as 1 — silent defaults on malformed sim fields, violating the ODN-5 fail-fast bar (r1 #9 covered Float only).
recommended_fix: Add a default case returning (0, false) so any non-Integer JSON type rejects with the named error; keep missing-key -> (def, true).

title: load_demo_replay drops the pre-existing demo.nodes/draws/spawns backing frees — three dynamic arrays leak per replay/drift invocation
evidence:
Current (abe578b): "delete(demo.demolishes) // r1 note: the sibling loaders leaked this too
	delete(demo.captures)
	return cfg" — base v2 (git show v2:harness/run.odin): "delete(demo.nodes)
	delete(demo.draws)
	delete(demo.spawns)
	delete(demo.captures)
	return cfg"
detail: The r1 demolishes fix landed, but the same hunk dropped the pre-existing demo.nodes/draws/spawns backing frees — each load_demo_replay (drift-check ×9 demos, run_replay) now leaks three dynamic arrays. Strings are cfg-owned (demo_replay_destroy frees them), so no double-free; one-shot CLI, hygiene only.
recommended_fix: Restore delete(demo.nodes); delete(demo.draws); delete(demo.spawns) alongside the demolishes delete — demo_replay_destroy frees only cfg strings, so no double-free.

title: ODN-7 plan_pressure proc-field seam deferred — flow_step hardcodes scripted_plan_pressure instead of calling through Run_Config
evidence: core/flow.odin:198 "plan := scripted_plan_pressure(cat, state.era, tick)" — core/demand.odin:22-24 "The full ODN-7 seam (a plan_pressure proc field on a Run_Config, swappable for the V2 AI auditor) is [LATER] — 3.1 binds the scripted impl directly."
detail: ODN-7 mandates the director behind a Run_Config.plan_pressure proc field ('PROTO binds scripted_plan_pressure ... behind the same field'); flow_step hardcodes the call instead. Read-only discipline is structurally honored (no Run_State handle); the future AI-auditor swap must edit flow_step. Documented deferral.
recommended_fix: Accept as documented [LATER], or bind the proc field now (config.plan_pressure = scripted_plan_pressure) so flow_step calls through the seam unchanged when the auditor lands.
